# Originary

Originary creates portable signed records for agent actions, API calls, MCP
tool runs, gateway decisions, payments, approvals, and provisioning. A record
is issued by a system that observed or reported the action and can be verified
offline with the supplied public key.

When an agent or API action is reviewed or disputed, those records can be
assembled into a bounded evidence case, so another organization can verify what
each issuer reported and identify what evidence is missing, without access to
private logs or an Originary-hosted verifier.

Current protocol release: PEAC v0.16.3 "Gateway Decision Evidence", which adds
a gateway decision evidence profile over the existing access-decision record,
a runnable offline-verifiable example, and an integrator guide. The wire format
is unchanged. Earlier evidence patterns remain available: paid resources, paid
MCP tool records, linked counterparty acknowledgments, Merkle commitment
helpers, external evidence anchoring, agent spend attribution, agent run
lineage records, action approval records, and runtime lineage exports.

Last updated: 2026-07-27

Organization: Originary (legal entity: Poem, Inc.)
Location: Delaware, USA
Contact: contact@originary.xyz

## What it is

Verifiable records for agents, APIs, and gateways. Each record is issued by a
system that observed or reported the action, and verifies offline against the
issuer's public key. For reviewed or disputed actions, Originary connects
selected signed records and native artifacts into an evidence case, so another
organization can verify what each issuer reported and identify what evidence is
still missing, without internal logs, dashboard access, or vendor runtime.

## Open protocol

PEAC Protocol is an Apache-2.0 open-source project for portable signed
interaction records, maintained by Originary.

- https://github.com/peacprotocol/peac

## Notes

Originary does not replace gateways, observability, payment rails, policy
engines, or runtimes. It records selected facts so another party can later
verify what the issuer recorded.
